title: 08/22/2025 - Software Updates
content:
## 08/22/2025 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105834

We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website.

- Implemented a security update to the Private Member Chat Add-On.

- Updated the Admin Dashboard UI to display New Members Signups, Recent Logins, Top Profile and Post Views, and the Total Engagement Overview for sites that have the Member Profile Analytics Add-On active.

- Updated the Admin modal pop-up to display in full-screen when using the new Quick Create action buttons.

- Fixed an issue that caused the Newsletter Campaigns feature in the Admin to display an error message when calculating qualifying recipients in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that caused the Search Members logic to store the company name in the last_name variable when the member’s listing type is set to "Company" in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Member - Search Query

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Google Sitemap Generator Add-On from generating sitemap files properly in some cases.

- Fixed an issue with the Billing Date Format Setting not changing correctly when the Date Format Setting on the General Settings page in the Admin is updated.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Account Menu from toggling when viewing the Private Member Chat page on the Member Dashboard from a mobile device in some cases. Widget Involved: Form - Froala Editor Javascript
